# Hire Me Now
> Resume writing, career strategy, LinkedIn guidance and interview preparation for newcomers, international students, career changers and professionals across Canada, led by Julia Cher.

## About
Hire Me Now is a Toronto-based career coaching service founded by Julia Cher, who has 15+ years of experience in employment services and private career coaching. The service helps job seekers who are not getting interviews understand what is blocking results, strengthen their positioning, and build a practical job search strategy aligned with how Canadian employers hire.

Multilingual support is available in English, Russian, Spanish, Hebrew, Cantonese, Bengali, Hindi, and Urdu.

## Services
- [Career Clarity Session — $149 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): One-time strategy session including resume and LinkedIn review, job search pattern analysis, and a clear 2–4 week action plan.
- [Resume Strategy Package — $349 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): One targeted resume, cover letter, LinkedIn positioning guidance, and application direction for one clear target role.
- [Multi-Path Career Strategy — $549 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): Two targeted resumes, two cover letters, interview preparation, offer evaluation guidance, and ongoing feedback for job seekers pursuing two directions or a career pivot.
- [LinkedIn Optimization — from $149 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): Standalone add-on to improve recruiter visibility and profile alignment.
- [Interview Preparation — from $99 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): Standalone add-on for answer preparation, delivery, and practice.
- [Labour Market Research & Career Direction — from $125 CAD](https://hiremenowresumes.ca/services.html): Identify realistic target roles and understand where your background fits in Canada.

## Who We Help
- Newcomers and internationally trained professionals translating experience for the Canadian market
- International students and new graduates entering the Canadian workforce
- Career changers building a clear story around transferable skills
- Professionals applying without results who need a focused strategy

## Founder
Julia Cher is the founder and lead strategist at Hire Me Now. Julia Cher holds two credentials from Career Professionals of Canada (CPC): Certified Career Practitioner and Certified Resume Strategist (CRS). She has over 15 years of experience helping job seekers compete in the Canadian labour market across industries and career levels.
